name: Celestial Surge
description: Celestial Surge (homebrew). Enable Celestial Surge in the module settings to get the Apply button on draws.

results.description: For the next minute, roll on the Celestial Surge table at the start of each of your turns (ignore this result on those rolls).

results.name: Burn the Non-believers
results.description: You are covered in sacred flames. Each creature within 20 ft makes a CON save against your spell save DC, taking 4d8 fire + 4d8 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.
